answer: The solver stakes a lotus-seed bond that is slashed if the identity behaves maliciously. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each new agent reputation slot must solve a unique, memory-hard puzzle whose difficulty rises with the number of registrations in an epoch, like a canyon narrowing as the tide rises. An attacker wanting N identities must pay N times the compute and capital, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
